I'd like an illustration of Elisia from Honkai Impact 3rd wearing a pink maid outfit.
It's for my personal enjoyment, and I'd like to use it as an icon.

Hello Sparks! I've once again wished to commission you and hope you entertain my silly idea. I wanted to ask you, if you'd be willing to make something similar for me like you did with Platinum and her various expressions? It would be for my OC Iris, just like last time. (´• ω •`) You may freely pick each of the expressions, how many you wish to do and whether she wears her standard outfit or the one you've created for her back then! For reference, she has the personality of a teasing older sister...although she is clumsy. Thank you for considering me (´ ω `♡)

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10Bvwdv_Lg07nucZ4Lfshp2d2LoLtoF_P?usp=sharing

Hi Sparks!
I would love to comm 2 separate drawings my OCs!
Here is Lilyth, I would love to see her drawn in your style again! She's confident, sassy, a little evil, and I often use pink threads as symbolism for some of her Star Wars mind control powers. Feel free to be dynamic with her and have fun!
Refs (use her main outfit - on the right of her ref sheet): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1B9lbPf84ehMHc5WJZnAIoLj34R4Dg1KC?usp=sharing

The other character is Elise, she is a deer lady (native american myth) and is described as a master manipulator, has spun webs of lies & control, etc. Creative sly and cunning poses and expressions work, have fun! Optionally, feel free to use any extra bg shapes or elements too with her that you feel fit (strings, snakes, nature, radiation, fog, etc). She is my Fallout dnd campaign OC. Her main ref in the drive has more info:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1bUMS5G6H0RQZSqyIvNFZKkMzaKw4zRiJ?usp=sharing
Thank you!

Hi!
I would like to commission you an illustration for a song cover video.
It would be for the song "Rubia".

It would have my original character (reference: https://i.imgur.com/5Ygz0im.jpeg) in a similar composition to Fu Hua in this shot from the original scene: https://i.imgur.com/3NOZ28r.jpeg
Feel free to adjust the pose and background as you like!

- Please draw my original character with white hair and red tips / strands, like Fu Hua.
- Please draw her with red eyes instead of yellow
- Please draw her with clothes that look more similar to Fu Hua (I'll leave the details up to you)

I'd love if it could remind of the original emotions from the game!

Please make an image with 16:9 format.
Also, if you could send another version with transparent background, it would be great!

Thank you for reading my request.
Have a nice day!

- Her job is Viper, she acts gracefully and deadly.

Thanks for your consideration~

I'm not sure if I've offered enough for a work of this style, so if it's not enough please request a resend with an amended amount!

Thanks for your consideration with this~
